# Resistor colour decoder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/resistor-colors/

Decode four- or five-band resistor values and tolerance. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Decode brown, black, red and gold as a four-band resistor.

## Limits and checks

Read band direction and verify parts with a meter when needed. The decoder does not identify damaged or nonstandard components from a photo.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
